policy: Keep raw statuses, isolate Vitest deadline detections, and qualify any behavioral equivalence by the stated input and ownership contract.

classifications.unconstrained explicit-undefined metadat: A missing optional memory metadata field becomes an explicit undefined property instead of being omitted. Defined metadata is independently checked through publication, reservation and dead-letter transitions. Property reads and JSON agree, but own-property enumeration differs; this is not unconditional JavaScript shape equivalence.
classifications.conditional publication-overlay equivale: For ordinary non-reentrant ID generation, stagedJobs contains the existing map plus insertions, so overlaying all staged entries produces the same state and insertion order without clearing first. Reentrant injected factories can affect adapter state and are outside this proof; unconditional equivalence is not claimed.
classifications.bounded extra reservation traversal: The validated positive capacity and slice(0, remaining) still prevent extra reservations when capacity is zero. Removing this shortcut performs extra pure ready-job traversals/sorts; results remain bounded but CPU work differs, so it is not a strict performance equivalence.
classifications.unconstrained diagnostic text: The tests assert rejection type and pre-mutation/pre-SQL behavior for invalid reservation values. Exact human-readable validation labels are not a stable public contract.
classifications.equivalent empty-publication pipeline: Removing this fast return runs normalization and an empty local publish loop, still returning [] without executing SQL. The counting-adapter test verifies zero database calls. Only additional local allocations/traversal differ.
classifications.equivalent absent-identity lookup: With this single mutation, existingByIdentity contains only defined identity keys, so looking up undefined returns undefined just as the original short-circuit does. Defined identities retain the original map lookup and comparison.
classifications.equivalent unused identity-map entry: Adding a local undefined-key entry for an unkeyed job is unobservable because the unchanged lookup branch never reads that key. The map remains internal and only explicit string identities participate in the database identity read/lock set.
classifications.mutated module rejected during import: The instrumented module failed before a behavior assertion ran. RuntimeError is kept separate from direct detections; schema validity is covered by direct export and SQL-expression tests.
classifications.equivalent inferred SQL column name: Drizzle replaces an empty builder name with its TypeScript property key. At this exact site the explicit SQL name and property key are identical, so the actual exported column mapping remains unchanged. Camel-case to snake-case sites are separately checked and are not part of this equivalence.
classifications.equivalent native timestamp-mode fallbac: The installed Drizzle timestamp factory selects string mode only for mode === "string"; both "date" and the mutated empty value select PgTimestampBuilder. Actual exported-schema tests confirm the Date data type and timezone-aware SQL type. Re-review when changing Drizzle.
classifications.deferred optional schema-description sur: The mutation removes per-column descriptions while leaving the required table description and executable schema intact. This changes introspection/documentation metadata and is not strict equivalence. Actual metadata wording is not pinned solely to improve a score; description-presence contracts can be added if this tooling surface is prioritized.

classifications.unconstrained diagnostic text: Error categories, native causes, numeric limits, routing behavior, lifecycle outcomes and cleanup are checked separately. Exact human-readable validation/error/log/drain labels are not pinned solely to improve the mutation score.
classifications.unconstrained synthesized missing-owner: Both paths reject an unknown namespace before any owner runs. Removing the explicit guard produces native TypeError on undefined.complete instead of the synthesized Error; the current contract/tests require an Error rejection but do not fix this synthetic subtype/message. Error shape differs, so strict equivalence is not claimed.
classifications.noncritical CLI help text: The contributed command, dependency, runtime, workload and execution are checked. This variant changes only the human-readable help description; exact wording is not a pinned behavior contract.
classifications.equivalent absent optional scheduler set: Forcing the branch to include an absent service adds an internal setting whose value is undefined. WorkerScheduler reads the value rather than own-property presence, preserving its optional default. Present service objects are covered separately.
classifications.unconstrained explicit-undefined definit: An absent optional field is returned explicitly as undefined rather than omitted. Defined values, defaults and behavior are independently covered. Ordinary reads and JSON agree, but own-property enumeration differs; this is not strict JavaScript object-shape equivalence.

classifications.equivalent under internal result and bra: A dense one-error result guarantees result.errors[0] exists, so optional chaining is redundant there. The >1 to >=1 variants follow an earlier length===1 throw without intervening mutation/callback. These facts apply only to the unchanged internal result builder and branch order.
classifications.unconstrained diagnostic text: The public rejection/error category and error aggregation contract remain unchanged; exact human-readable/internal diagnostic labels are not a stable API. Caller-originated serializer error identity is separately tested.
classifications.unconstrained optional metadata represen: Forcing an undefined-option branch false adds an explicit undefined property instead of omitting it. Defined option values still flow unchanged. Reads/JSON publication agree, but own-property enumeration differs; strict JavaScript object-shape equivalence is not claimed.
classifications.equivalent omitted-budget comparison: For an omitted validated budget, actual > undefined evaluates false. Performing that pure comparison instead of short-circuiting therefore preserves unlimited policy, while finite supplied budgets remain checked.
classifications.unconstrained synthesized serialization: Without the explicit undefined-root guard, native JSON.parse(undefined) throws a SyntaxError rather than the internally synthesized TypeError. The public WorkerPayloadSerializationError wrapper and pre-write rejection remain; exact synthetic cause shape differs and is not promised. Do not classify this as unconditional equivalence. Caller-supplied toJSON errors retain exact cause identity in separate tests.
classifications.equivalent native Buffer encoding fallba: Buffer.byteLength uses UTF-8 for this unsupported empty encoding, preserving byte counts for primitive serialized JSON strings under the current Node contract. Re-review on Node encoding semantics changes.

classifications.coalesced cycle ownership: runOnce returns the current cycle while present and never replaces it until this finalizer runs. The activeCycle identity guard is redundant under the current private write sites.
classifications.poll livelock protection: The mutation removes the loop body and spins without a cooperative turn. Stryker's external execution limit protects the run. This stays a raw timeout.
classifications.post-single-error count guard: The length-one case throws the original cause before this check; >=1 and >1 are identical on the remaining zero-or-many domain.
classifications.diagnostic text: Error wording is informative. Tests require the error category, propagation and queue effect where contractual.
classifications.second deferral drain: All invocation promises settle before the first deferral flush, which drains all current callbacks and failures. The later cleanup flush has no newly admitted work under that ownership order.
classifications.optional outcome representation: Omission and explicit undefined differ in property enumeration. Defined metadata and zero-valued overrides are checked. The specified consumers use property reads, nullish defaults and serialized payloads.
classifications.initial completion collection: The fabricated string entry lacks a tracked job ID and is skipped by the ownership gate before the configured sink. Its extra local iteration does not submit a result under valid job identities.
classifications.unknown queue integrity boundary: A conforming adapter returns jobs from a requested configured queue and the scheduler derives the queue internally. A corrupted reservation record or handler mutating job metadata can reach the defensive error; the report retains that uncovered boundary.

classifications.diagnostic text: Error wording is informative. Tests require the error category, propagation and queue effect where contractual.
classifications.scheduler defaults and constructor wirin: Production provider forwards parsed defaults and explicit clocks. Direct construction guards are tested. Remaining equivalent option/default substitutions, fallback callbacks and absent optional adapter grouping affect representation or isolated defaults; changing their consumers warrants new assertions.
classifications.application signal contract: Production App has a shutdown signal. Runtime-like objects without it require an invalid or alternate host; workers separately exercise actual application, release and expire cancellation.
classifications.shutdown state and redundant local remov: Completed transitions and nonwaiting release are covered. A redundant delete can retain a token locally after a successful release until that already-started cycle finishes. Storage generation checks prevent release of a newer owner. A secondary count check follows the single-error throw.
classifications.pressure configuration invariant: Constructor rejects pressure without a throttling facade and any nonlocal constraint, including mixed policies. The inner missing-facade guard is therefore defensive for immutable constructor state.
classifications.empty late reservation work: Calling a conforming adapter with no reservations is a no-op. A different guard can add an empty local adapter call. All three late-reservation shutdown policies are tested with real reservations.
classifications.lease renewal ownership: The shared heartbeat stops on the execution signal, and renewal filters token ownership. Nonrenewed tokens are forgotten and wake the relevant invocation. Extra renewal checks and absent tracked-state guards protect a race with already-confirmed writes.
classifications.reservation generation invariant: One active cycle records reserved jobs before invocation creation. The token and ownership guards defend stale references, already-committed transitions and inconsistent adapter results. Reclaimed leases are tested with a real replacement token and an unaffected peer.
classifications.batch construction and optional executio: Full and partial batch boundaries and publisher-linked executions are covered. Omitting or explicitly setting an absent optional ID differs in own-property shape and has the same constructor argument read.
classifications.preparation, accounting and permit compl: Invalid stored input, async validation cancellation, unavailable facade, duplicate accounting, late grants and scope-open rejection are exercised. Remaining defensive abort/failure ordering, fallback feedback and explicit undefined properties are retained. A conforming permit may reject an infrastructure operation, leaving lease replay to storage.
classifications.admission cancellation and retry: All unavailable classes, unexpected abort with a live signal, late grants and first/held/fallback deadlines have direct queue-state tests. In the aborted paths the slot gate and deferral filter also reject an already-lost invocation; isolated edits can still alter optional diagnostics or attempted internal work.
classifications.hold budget accounting: A later cycle reuses released budget, and partial drain retains capacity occupied by a peer. Remaining sites concern a private hold-only guard, keeping a zero entry under a bounded worker-name key, and selecting slots instead of batch size for the default batch hold budget. That last variant can change the timing of batch deferral.
classifications.defer ownership and cleanup: Batch peers still owned after a loss are returned without spending attempts. The adapter validates the captured token, so additional stale requests have no durable effect with conforming adapters, but extra storage work and defensive cancellation ordering can differ.
classifications.optional retry observation: A held decision can omit retryAt or carry an explicit undefined. Consumers read the optional value. Diagnostic reporting exceptions are tested independently of durable admission.
classifications.cancel reason identity: The gate rethrows the exact signal reason. Handler exceptions generally become job outcomes, so distinguishable arbitrary rejection after abort involves failing execution/scope infrastructure. Current cancellation and ordinary failed scope boundaries are tested.
classifications.optional execution observation: Worker log context, completed outcomes, original causes and cleanup when observation setup/start/completion throws are asserted. Absence of an observer, error projection representation and defensive original-error/catch paths are kept as raw residuals.
classifications.validated cost and batch policy invarian: Null and malformed requirements, mixed advanced policy cost, different policy/dimensions, and negative/nonfinite costs fail before acquiring. Empty invocation and missing throttling are guarded by the caller, and some malformed-value variants still fail with the same error category at the next validation boundary.
classifications.reporting outside configured admission: Unconfigured context hooks are tested through real dead-letter outcomes. Residual message text and internal argument shape are preserved without requiring English wording.
classifications.slot waiter lifetime: The slot handoff and stopped-propagation race are tested without wall-clock waits. A native abort subscription is disposed before handing off the slot; defensive removal of a waiter absent from its private queue and secondary checks are retained.
